name: omp-llm-role
description: omp plugin: daily model-role updater driven by llm-stats/OpenRouter rankings

switchMargin.description: Value margin a challenger must beat the incumbent by before switching

priceSwitchFraction.description: Adopt a challenger inside the margin when it is at least this fraction cheaper (0 disables)

writeFallbackChains.description: Write per-role fallback chains into config.yml

fallbackChainDepth.description: Number of fallback models per role chain

activateDefaultOnEmptySession.description: Reapply the new default selector to an empty session's active model

roles.default.description.default: Main workhorse: strong general coding-agent quality, sane cost

roles.default.thinking.description: Thinking level appended to the default selector

roles.default.providerPin.description: Provider slug the default role's requests are pinned to (OpenRouter @<slug> routing; empty = default routing)

roles.default.cacheHitRate.description: Assumed cache-hit rate (0–1) for default's input tokens; blends each route's cache-read price before the 3:1 blend (0 = off)

roles.default.required.description: Comma-separated metrics a model must have to rank for default

roles.default.filters.image.description: Restrict the default pool to image-capable models

roles.default.filters.tools.description: Restrict the default pool to models with a tool-capable route

roles.default.filters.minContextTokens.description: Drop default routes whose endpoint context is below this (tokens; 0 = off)

roles.default.filters.minOutputTokens.description: Drop default routes whose endpoint output ceiling is below this (tokens; 0 = off)

roles.default.filters.maxPriceUsdPerM.description: Drop default models whose role-priced blend exceeds this ($/M; 0 = off)

roles.default.lambda.description: Explicit λ ($ per quality point) override for default

roles.default.weights.general.description: Weight of general in the default quality composite

roles.default.weights.code.description: Weight of code in the default quality composite

roles.default.weights.agents.description: Weight of agents in the default quality composite

roles.default.weights.tool_calling.description: Weight of tool_calling in the default quality composite

roles.default.weights.throughput.description: Weight of throughput in the default quality composite

roles.default.weights.price.description: Weight of price in the default quality composite
